title: Help add-apt-repository work on Ubuntu derivatives
description: On certain Ubuntu derivatives, a different codename is used than the Ubuntu codename. This can be seen on Linux Mint, Elementary OS, Drauger OS, and others. This patch is to help distinguish that these distros are similar in nature to Ubuntu, and can be treated like it as well. It points add-apt-repository to the correct PPAs for a given distro, given that distro's Ubuntu base.
commit_message: Help add-apt-repository work on Ubuntu derivatives
